items.raw_excerpt: Nova data do exame é voltada para quem comprovou problemas logísticos no dia da aplicação regular da prova ou para quem teve alguma das doenças listadas em edital.
items.summary_en: Candidates can now check whether their request to retake Enamed was approved. The new test date is for people who had logistical problems on the original test day or one of the illnesses listed in the official notice.
items.summary_ko: ENAMED 응시자가 재응시 신청이 승인됐는지 확인할 수 있다. 새 시험일은 시험 당일 응시에 차질을 빚었다는 것을 입증한 사람이나 공고에 명시된 질병을 앓은 응시자를 대상으로 한다.

items.raw_excerpt: BHEL Ranipet marks Gandhi Jayanti with tributes, student performances, and a Swachhatha Swachotsav cleaning drive on campus.
items.summary_en: The BHEL plant in Ranipet, Tamil Nadu celebrated Gandhi Jayanti. Workers and students paid tribute to Gandhi and held student performances. They also joined a campus cleanliness drive called Swachhatha Swachotsav.
items.summary_ko: 타밀나두 라니펫의 BHEL 사업장이 간디 탄신일을 기념했습니다. 임직원과 학생들이 간디에게 헌화하고 학생 공연을 선보였습니다. 캠퍼스 청소 행사인 스와차타 스와차초사브에도 함께 참여했습니다.
items.title_ko: BHEL 라니펫, 간디 탄신일 기념 행사 열어
items.title_original: BHEL celebrates Gandhi Jayanthi in Ranipet

items.raw_excerpt: Blasha & Allatt, Blck Mamba and Young Marco are among the artists heading to Humbeek this September.
items.summary_en: Voodoo Village is a festival in Humbeek, Belgium. Organizers announced the first artists for the 2026 edition. Blasha & Allatt, Blck Mamba and Young Marco will play there this September.

items.raw_excerpt: Neste domingo (4), a governadora e candidata à reeleição, Raquel Lyra (PSD), votará, às 8h55, no Colégio Diocesano de Caruaru. Na sequência, no município do Agreste, Raquel acompanhará a votação do pai e ex-governador, João Lyra Neto, e do seu filho, João Lyra Filho, que irá dar o seu primeiro voto. No final da manhã, […]
items.summary_en: On Sunday, Governor Raquel Lyra will vote in Caruaru at 8:55 a.m. Later she will watch her father and her son vote. Her son is casting his first-ever vote.

items.raw_excerpt: Dolly Parton’s nephew wants more time to get a lawyer in place to defend himself against a temporary restraining order granted to her estate against him and his security company. Representing himself, Bryan Seaver filed a motion Friday in a Tennessee court asking that a hearing on the order now…
items.summary_en: Bryan Seaver is representing himself in a Tennessee court. On Friday he filed a motion to delay a hearing on a temporary restraining order. The order was given to Dolly Parton's estate against him and his security company.

items.raw_excerpt: The emblems for the Brisbane 2032 Olympics and Paralympics have been accidentally leaked by the Games' official YouTube channel, ruining its own a grand unveiling slated for Monday.

items.raw_excerpt: Lisbon is beautiful to explore on foot, but driving through its historic centre is another experience altogether.
items.summary_en: Lisbon is lovely to walk around, but driving in its old centre feels very different. The narrow streets and old buildings make the trip a special experience. This piece looks at what it is like to drive there.
items.summary_ko: 리스본은 걸어 다니기 아름답지만, 오래된 중심부를 차로 달리는 경험은 전혀 다릅니다. 좁은 길과 오래된 건물들 덕분에 특별한 여행이 됩니다. 이 기사는 그곳에서 운전하는 느낌을 전합니다.
